Unlike the other ordering keys (backlog_order, sprint_order, kanban_order) which are columns on the already-filtered queryset, this allows a user to reference any epic id from any project. Because the serializer (serializers.py:84-93) returns `obj.epic_order` whenever include_epic_order is True, a requester who is not a member of the project that owns `epic_id` can probe/leak the epic-order position of user stories associated with that epic (and, via the unsanitized interpolation, a SQL injection / arbitrary SQL execution). This exposes data not gated by the project membership authorization that Taiga applies elsewhere.
